query:
WITH candidates AS (
                SELECT id
                FROM actions
                WHERE dataplane_id = $1
                  AND deployment_id IS NULL
                  AND (
                        status = 'pending'
                     OR (status = 'leased' AND leased_until < $2)
                  )
                ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
                LIMIT $4
                FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
            )
            UPDATE actions
            SET status = 'leased',
                leased_until = $3
            WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM candidates)
            RETURNING id,
                      deployment_id,
                      dataplane_id,
                      action_type,
                      target_kind,
                      target_id,
                      payload,
                      version,
                      status,
                      status_at,
                      status_agent_id,
                      status_reason,
                      source_type,
                      source_user_id,
                      source_client_id,
                      constraints_not_after,
                      constraints_priority,
                      created_at,
                      leased_until
